comments.value: You have to learn that in most cases. If it's a bad rank on PC. The quest version is probably the exact same avatar.

@{5e44a1bd0c91c2477a8b8acb|full_name}: Problem is: do Quest user know it? I am afraid NOT. They cannot see how "bad" or "heavy" PC side is. It's not fault of Quest user, because i cannot see the performance rank of PC side as Quest user. There is no indication. 
BTW it's very possible Quest avatar is just nice Medium, while PC is Very Poor. You cannot imagine that for Quest user.
Add rank in Avatar menu is advised, to avoid misunderstandings.

details:
I discovered for a while something is not right, because now we have more avatars with PC + Quest side together. Sounds no problem?

Now, there is actually one big problem for Quest side.
This is not big problem for PC side, because we can control better avatars and we can see which avatars are Medium / Poor / Very Poor Perf. ranked, but how about from Quest side? Well, they can see the avatars have Medium / Poor Perf. rank.

But avatars with both sides, if Quest user pick the avatar, which Performance rank is PC side actually? Can they see it? I noticed some Quest avatars with pc side have even Poor / Very Poor Perf. ranking at PC side. And that is a problem in busy rooms, especially events and lessons. Then i go ask Quest user to change avatar, but they will not understand immediately why they should change avatar. They don't know and cannot see the PC side is actually too heavy avatar! There is no clear indication in the avatar listing PC side is Poor / Very Poor Performance rank.

That is not great. Quest users should see the PC side is heavy one in the listing.
Actually we should do it same for PC side: it's possible the Quest side can too heavy. Then we will change to better optimized avatar - for both sides. Because if Quest user pick the Medium Quest side, and it has very poor PC avatar, that doesn't make any sense! It will give false idea for Quest user the avatar is good and optimized.

In another words: poorly made avatars exists. We don't want cause problems for PC side, but we don't also not cause problems for Quest side, right? 

Please adjust the avatar overview so it will show Performance ranking better for both sides. So we can check the avatar is good or bad by ourselves.
Thank you. This will avoid confusion and misunderstanding why avatar is actually not good if someone ask you to change avatar.
title: No visible PC side Avatar Performance ranking for Quest users
